0022600204.text: The Hornets (3-7, 2-4 at home) host Cleveland in their 11th game of the season, arriving on a six-game losing streak and sitting 10th in the East and fourth in the Southeast, 3.5 games back. Cleveland (5-5, 4-2 at home) is seventh in the East and second in the Central, 1.5 games back, after a loss in its most recent game, and the teams have not played yet in 2026-27. In 2025-26 the Hornets lost the season series 1-3, most recently 118-113 in Charlotte on February 20, 2026. Charlotte is without Brandon Miller (groin soreness), Dennis Schroder (hamstring strain), Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) is day-to-day and a game-time decision; Cleveland is missing Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow), and Jarrett Allen (knee) is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
